proposed_statement_changes.reason: The corrected one-arc certificate does not enumerate irrelevant two-dimensional stationary points: the proved strict coordinate monotonicity rules out every such optimizer, the forward arc is represented by complementing the confounder, and all legal canonical-arc stationary points and singular continua remain certified.  The proposed claim is the exact operational guarantee proved by the current certificate construction.

The one-arc strict inequalities rule out the constant-confounder corners whenever the model is not point identified, so every endpoint has an optimizer with strictly interior posterior probabilities.  In the point-identified cases the pair \(w_0=w_1=1/2\) is strictly interior.  The earlier closure-only endpoint language is therefore unnecessarily weak; the proof establishes the exact equality of the causal images of the positive and closed classes while retaining the explicit no-transfer historical qualification.

prose_updates.tldr: For binary treatment, outcome, and one shared latent binary confounder within finitely many observed strata, the causal ATE image is exactly the same interval \([L,R]\) over the strictly positive class and its finite-simplex closure.  Both arms are optimized at one common posterior pair.  A strict tilt-gap derivative argument reduces every non-point-identified stratum endpoint to the canonical arc \(w_0=W_{\Gamma_A}(t),w_1=t\) with \(0<t<1\); point-identified exceptions are attained by \(w_0=w_1=1/2\), so closure is not needed for endpoint attainment.  The fixed-input certificate and parametric tipping atlas operate one-dimensionally while retaining denominator checks, legal-root collisions, and stationary continua.  The complete rational transcript \((\mathrm{C1})\)--\((\mathrm{C10})\) certifies a stable strict gap relative to the internal separate-pair relaxation.  Regular zero-frontier points have the proved root-\(n\) normal-displacement law, while uniformly honest inference at ties, collisions, continua, and higher-order contact remains the singular-only open question.

project_justification.gap: The fixed-tuple binary-confounder calculation of Rosenbaum and Rubin does not optimize this maintained bounded common-posterior region or prove its positive-class endpoint attainment.  Propensity-only, arbitrary-confounder, and exposure-standardization models use different primitives.  Absent an observable-law-dependent translation, the paper asserts no nesting or numerical-dominance relation between those published models and the maintained class.
project_justification.niche: The restriction is scientifically interpretable and algebraically low dimensional: strict coordinate monotonicity reduces shared-posterior optimization to one exposure-odds arc, places every nontrivial endpoint at an interior posterior pair, and preserves the compatibility information removed by the armwise relaxation.
project_justification.fill: The paper supplies the exact equality \(\tau(\mathcal M^{\circ})=\tau(\mathcal M)=[L,R]\), strictly positive endpoint-attaining laws, a canonical one-arc reduction, a degeneracy-complete fixed-input certificate, a parametric algebraic tipping atlas, the complete \((\mathrm{C1})\)--\((\mathrm{C10})\) strict-gap witness, point-identification and Manski-limit reductions, and pointwise regular-frontier inference; only singular uniform frontier inference remains open.

sampling_model.overlap: Every observed stratum satisfies \(0<p_x<1\) and \(0<r_{a,x}<1\).  At finite budgets, every sharp endpoint is attained with \(0<w_{a,x}<1\): nontrivial endpoints use an interior point of the canonical arc, and point-identified exceptions use \(w_{0,x}=w_{1,x}=1/2\).  Vanishing latent treatment positivity appears only along the joint all-budget path used for Manski recovery.

prose_updates.related_work: Rosenbaum and Rubin \cite{RosenbaumRubin1983Sensitivity} are retained only as the fixed-tuple binary-confounder comparator; the verified source does not establish equality with, or an inclusion direction for, this paper's arm-specific two-sided bounded class, arbitrary conditional potential-outcome coupling, or finite-simplex closure.  VanderWeele and Arah \cite{VanderWeeleArah2011Bias} motivate the binary-confounder bias decomposition.  Ding and VanderWeele \cite{DingVanderWeele2016WithoutAssumptions} give a sharp arbitrary-\(U\) relative-risk factor, while Tan \cite{Tan2006MarginalSensitivity}, Yadlowsky et al. \cite{YadlowskyEtAl2022Bounds}, and Dorn and Guo \cite{DornGuo2023QuantileBalancing} study propensity-based marginal sensitivity models.  Ciocănea-Teodorescu, Gabriel, and Sjölander \cite{CiocaneaGabrielSjolander2022Marginal} use exposure-standardization sensitivity parameters, and Nabi et al. \cite{NabiEtAl2024SemiparametricSensitivity} provide an adjacent tilt-model framework.  Absent a proved observable-law-dependent translation, no nesting or numerical-dominance relation is asserted between any of those published models and the maintained common-binary-\(U\) class.  The separate-posterior-pair interval is instead an internal relaxation obtained by dropping only the shared-pair constraint, and the complete rational transcript proves a strict open-set gap against it.  Masten and Poirier \cite{MastenPoirier2020BreakdownFrontier} motivate the tipping frontier, Fang and Santos \cite{FangSantos2019InferenceDirectional} motivate nonsmooth inference, and Manski \cite{Manski1990TreatmentResponse} is recovered only in the joint infinite-budget limit with vanishing latent positivity.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The one-arc theorem removes two-dimensional interior searches and duplicate forward-arc enumeration, and it also proves that finite-budget endpoints are attained in the strictly positive class.  The worked rational witness is fully certified by the explicit \((\mathrm{C1})\)--\((\mathrm{C10})\) polynomial, Sturm, interval-Newton, legal-cell, and competitor transcript.  The fixed-input certificate and parametric atlas remain exact mathematical procedures rather than complexity guarantees for a software implementation.  The regular inference theorem is pointwise and applies only to a unique nondegenerate active branch with nonzero budget gradient; uniformly honest Hausdorff inference at ties, legal-root collisions, stationary continua, and contact order \(k\geq2\) remains open.  No historical class transfer, nesting assertion, or numerical-dominance comparison with a published sensitivity model is claimed absent a proved observable-law-dependent translation.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The sharp population result concerns the maintained single-binary-confounder class with finite categorical \(X\), interior observed cells, and finite odds budgets.  Its causal image is identical over the strictly positive class and its explicitly defined finite-simplex closure: \(\tau(\mathcal M^{\circ})=\tau(\mathcal M)=[L,R]\).  Every nontrivial stratum endpoint lies at \(0<t<1\) on the canonical reverse exposure arc, with the forward arc recovered by complementing \(U\); \(\Gamma_A=1\) and \(\Gamma_0=\Gamma_1=1\) are point-identified and admit the strictly positive pair \(w_0=w_1=1/2\).  The odds ratio is not assigned a value at null cells.  The \((\mathrm{C1})\)--\((\mathrm{C10})\) transcript establishes the displayed common-versus-separate witness and its open-neighborhood strictness.  The zero-tipping surface has a parametric algebraic atlas, and unique regular branches have pointwise root-\(n\) normal-displacement inference; the open question is restricted to uniform inference on singular frontier strata.  Manski recovery is only the joint all-budget limit along vanishing latent treatment positivity.  Rosenbaum--Rubin remains a fixed-tuple comparator.  Without a proved observable-law-dependent translation, no nesting or numerical-dominance relation with a published model is asserted.

statement_notes.justification: This is the sharp population kernel: both potential-outcome arms are jointly realized through one latent confounder, strict tilt-gap monotonicity makes the endpoint map one-dimensional, and every endpoint is attained in the strictly positive class.
statement_notes.gap: The fixed-tuple Rosenbaum--Rubin comparator, exposure-standardization procedures, and propensity-only marginal sensitivity bounds do not give the equality \(\tau(\mathcal M^{\circ})=\tau(\mathcal M)=[L,R]\) or its canonical-arc reduction.  No class relation is asserted without a proved observable-law-dependent translation.
statement_notes.consumer: Investigators receive the narrowest valid ATE interval under the declared common-confounder budgets, strictly positive endpoint witnesses, and a one-dimensional map that exact certification and tipping analysis can consume.

statement_notes.gap: The internal armwise relaxation removes only common-posterior compatibility inside the present model.  No nesting or numerical-dominance relation with the Dorn--Guo marginal sensitivity model is asserted absent a proved observable-law-dependent translation; no published result isolates this shared-binary-posterior loss under simultaneous treatment and outcome odds budgets.
